heading: Coordination of Federal activities with adopted standards and implementation specifications

tree.heading: Spending on health information technology systems
tree.text: As each agency (as defined by the Director of the Office of Management and Budget, in consultation with the Secretary of Health and Human Services) implements, acquires, or upgrades health information technology systems used for the direct exchange of individually identifiable health information between agencies and with non-Federal entities, it shall utilize, where available, health information technology systems and products that meet standards and implementation specifications adopted under section 300jj–14 of this title, as added by section 13101.1

tree.heading: Federal information collection activities
tree.text: With respect to a standard or implementation specification adopted under section 300jj–14 of this title, as added by section 13101, the President shall take measures to ensure that Federal activities involving the broad collection and submission of health information are consistent with such standard or implementation specification, respectively, within three years after the date of such adoption.

tree.heading: Application of definitions
tree.text: The definitions contained in section 300jj of this title, as added by section 13101,1 shall apply for purposes of this subchapter.

notes.text: References in TextSection 13101, referred to in text, means section 13101 of div. A of Pub. L. 111–5.
